current_date: November 2023 (title: 'The Local List: Information required to support a valid planning application', November 2023)
current_evidence: The November 2023 list is the latest adopted list found. On 6 August 2025 the Planning Committee approved a revised draft Local Validation List for a 4-week consultation, with adoption to follow at a later committee. The report says the current list was last reviewed in summer 2023. The council's 'Apply for planning permission' page could not be fetched, so it is not confirmed whether the revised list has since been adopted.

issues.detail: A revised Local Validation List was approved for consultation on 6 August 2025 (draft at chichester.moderngov.co.uk/documents/s30587/10.1 Appendix 1 - CDC_Local_Validation_List.pdf). If it has since been adopted, the November 2023 link is outdated; the workbook doesn't mention the review. The November 2023 list also predates the Chichester Local Plan 2021-2039 (adopted August 2025), yet still cites old-plan policies such as 'Policy 50 and 51'.
issues.evidence: Planning Committee 6 Aug 2025: 'Recommendations Approved' - Draft Local List agreed for consultation; report: list 'last formally reviewed in summer 2023'.

issues.detail: Grokbot also read the superseded July 2017 Local List (CDC_Local_List.pdf) and mixed it into the data. Tab items 8, 9 and 19-23 come from it, and so do several app-type rows: Block plan, Cycle parking, 'Schedule of works (listed building)', LBC Lighting Assessment and Change of use - prior approval Contaminated Land.
issues.evidence: Tab item: 'CDC Local Validation List July 2017 Page 14 ...'; rows sourced from CDC_Local_List.pdf.

issues.detail: Householder shows '(none) - national requirements only', which is wrong. The Nov 2023 list applies several local requirements to householder work: FRA ('all development (including extensions)' in Flood Zones 2/3); Heritage Statement (listed building curtilage, conservation areas, archaeological areas); AONB Statement ('All development within the AONB'); Tree Survey/AIA ('any new building work (including construction of access drive, patios...)'); CIL forms (extensions of 100 sqm+ and annexes); protected species surveys; water neutrality (householder pools and annexes in the Sussex North WRZ); plans and drawings (block plan, elevations, floor plans, roof plan, sections/levels).
issues.evidence: Source s.6 FRA, s.9 Heritage, s.2 AONB, s.5A CIL, s.4C water neutrality 'excluding householder works other than pools and annexes', s.17 Plans and Drawings 'applies to all applications'.

issues.detail: Outline and Reserved matters both show '(none)', but most Part II requirements (affordable housing, ecology/BNG, HRA mitigation, FRA, drainage, transport, contamination, etc.) apply to outline applications. The Affordable Housing Statement explicitly mentions reserved matters, exempting them only where amount, mix or tenure is unchanged.
issues.evidence: s.1 Affordable Housing Statement: 'Excludes reserved matters with no change to amount, mix, or tenure.'

issues.detail: Summary of the inferred placements: 32 of the 36 Full planning rows are marked 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning'. The source applies its requirements by development type and threshold, not by application type, so the placements lose the triggers. Examples: Air Quality, BNG (major from Nov 2023, small sites from Apr 2024), Drainage, Lighting, Noise, Viability.
issues.evidence: Notes field 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text of a general local list' on 32 Full planning rows.

issues.detail: Two Works to trees rows are wrong. The Tree Survey/Arboricultural Implications & Method Statement is triggered by new building work near trees, not by TPO/conservation-area tree works applications. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is a mislabel: its excerpt is the same tree survey text.
issues.evidence: 'TREE SURVEY/ARBORICULTURAL IMPLICATIONS & METHOD STATEMENT When required An arboricultural impact appraisal (AIA) is required for any new building work (including construction of access drive, patios...'

issues.detail: Several Nov 2023 local requirements are not captured as requirement rows at all: (1) Affordable Housing Statement - net increase of 11+ units (6+ in the designated rural area). (2) AONB/Chichester Harbour Statement - all development within the AONB except LBC/LDC, and major/minor development outside settlement boundaries within 500m of the AONB; it appears only as tab_item fragments. (3) Interim Position Statement Justification - residential outside settlement boundaries. (4) Sustainable Construction and Design Statement - all new residential and commercial development, including replacement dwellings. (5) Odour Assessment (s.16) and Overheating/Ventilation Statement (s.15), both separate from Ventilation/Extraction. (6) Surface Water Drainage Statement for 1-4 dwellings or commercial under 1,000 sqm (8C). (7) Road Safety Audit (21B), visible only inside the Transport excerpt. (8) Heritage Statement for planning applications; it is captured only under LBC. (9) Tree survey/AIA for Full planning. (10) Coastal squeeze and Medmerry compensatory habitat statements, and the Exception Test (7B).
issues.evidence: Nov 2023 Local List Part II sections 1, 2, 7B, 8C, 9, 10, 15, 16, 21, 21B and 4C.

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are fragments or belong to a different requirement. BNG: 'to deliver BNG on that site.' (no major/small-site dates). HRA: starts mid-sentence 'Langstone Harbours SPA, or 2) 3.5km of the Pagham Harbour SPA.' (drops 'net increase in dwellings or holiday accommodation within 5.6km'). Water Neutrality: 'would achieve water neutrality, including;' (no Sussex North WRZ trigger). Viability: no trigger. Drainage Strategy/SuDS: quotes the foul/non-mains text instead of the 8B threshold (5+ dwellings or 1,000 sqm+). Transport Assessment: quotes the Road Safety Audit trigger instead of the 21A unit/floorspace thresholds.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger_excerpt fields as quoted; source s.4B, 4C, 8B, 21A.

issues.detail: Several requirement names don't match their excerpt. 'Ground investigation / Geotechnical / Basement Impact Assessment' is the water neutrality borehole yield text. 'Water efficiency / water usage statement' is water neutrality evidence about agricultural water use. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is the Planning Statement trigger. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' (Full planning) is the Structural Survey and Conversion Method Statement. 'Parking provision / Parking plan' reuses the EV charging excerpt, while the source's own Parking Assessment section is not captured.
issues.evidence: 'A hydrogeological assessment of water yield from the borehole is necessary...'; 'AND CONVERSION METHOD STATEMENT Understanding the structural condition of a building...'

issues.detail: Several tab items are process text or fragments, not requirements. Examples: 'Normally, the Council aims to complete this process within 3 – 5 working days' (twice, from the 2023 and 2017 lists); 'PART I - NATIONAL REQUIREMENTS Planning applications may be submitted either as an online application or in hard copy' (twice); 'A summary is not sufficient and PDF or Word formats will not be accepted. 3.'; 'North point (except elevation drawings) 18.'; 'Pagham Harbour SPA is covered by a similar scheme run by Chichester and Arun districts.'; 'Further information about ... can be found at' with the links missing.

The SPA recreational disturbance requirement appears twice, once from the 2023 list and once from the superseded 2017 list (tab items 18 and 21). The 2017 wording omits holiday accommodation, so the two versions conflict.
issues.evidence: 2023: 'net increase in dwellings or holiday accommodation within: 1) 5.6km...'; 2017: 'net increase of dwellings within: 1) 5.6km...'.

summary: Grokbot's November 2023 docx link works and is the latest adopted list found, but the council approved a revised draft for consultation in August 2025, so whether it is still current is unconfirmed. The extraction mixes in the superseded 2017 list and wrongly shows Householder, Outline and RM as having no local requirements. It also misses key items (Affordable Housing, AONB, Sustainable Construction, Interim Position Statement, Odour/Overheating) and has many mislabelled or fragmentary triggers.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
